item.essentialis.chakram.desc: Throw it to strike enemies from afar. It bounces off blocks and returns to you.
item.essentialis.hammer.desc: Mines a 3x3 area like an iron pickaxe and shovel combined. Repaired with iron blocks.
item.essentialis.wayback_stone.desc: Saves you from death, leaving one heart, and returns you to your spawn point. Grants 30 seconds of fire resistance. 15 minute cooldown.
enchantment.essentialis.bouncing.desc: Allows the chakram to ricochet to a nearby enemy after a hit. Each level adds one ricochet.
enchantment.essentialis.harvesting.desc: Harvests crops and foliage the chakram flies through.
enchantment.essentialis.lightweight.desc: Increases the chakram's flight range by 7.5 blocks per level.
enchantment.essentialis.phasing.desc: Allows the chakram to pass through enemies. Each level pierces one additional enemy.
enchantment.essentialis.ricochet.desc: Increases damage for each block the chakram has bounced off, plus 0.5 damage per level.
tooltip.essentialis.wayback_stone.line1: Cheats death and returns you to your respawn point.
item.essentialis.citrine_ring.desc: Highlights nearby enemies. Netherite upgrade extends the range and ignites undead.
item.essentialis.jade_ring.desc: Increases movement speed and jump height. Netherite upgrade doubles it and works while riding.
item.essentialis.ruby_ring.desc: Heals a portion of the damage you deal. Netherite upgrade doubles it.
item.essentialis.sapphire_ring.desc: Shortens burn time and speeds up swimming in water and lava. Netherite upgrade improves both.
item.essentialis.tanzanite_ring.desc: Doubles the duration of effects on you. Netherite upgrade only affects positive effects.
item.essentialis.topaz_ring.desc: Grants luck. Netherite upgrade doubles it and brings fortuitous finds.
Highlights nearby enemies in a wide range and ignites undead.
item.essentialis.netherite_jade_ring.des: Greatly increases movement speed and jump height, also while riding.
item.essentialis.netherite_ruby_ring.des: Heals a large portion of the damage you deal.
item.essentialis.netherite_sapphire_ring: Shortens burn time, greatly speeds up swimming and extends breath.
item.essentialis.netherite_tanzanite_rin: Doubles the duration of positive effects on you.
item.essentialis.netherite_topaz_ring.de: Grants great luck and fortuitous finds.
tooltip.essentialis.ring.ruby_ring.line1: Heals %s of the damage you deal.
tooltip.essentialis.ring.sapphire_ring.l: Burns %s shorter. %s speed in water and lava.

tooltip.essentialis.ring.loot.citrine_ri: Rare loot: mineshafts, outposts and mansions.
tooltip.essentialis.ring.loot.jade_ring: Rare loot: chests and barrels everywhere.
tooltip.essentialis.ring.loot.ruby_ring: Rare loot: nether fortresses and bastions.
tooltip.essentialis.ring.loot.sapphire_r: Rare loot: ocean ruins, shipwrecks and the drowned.
tooltip.essentialis.ring.loot.topaz_ring: Rare loot: chests and barrels everywhere.
